body: Context: found by hw3-final while fixing contrib/ent (round 3 of the hard-wire audit, tsk_01a120149db97bac9bb3853b4e412a1a). contrib/gorm/gorm.go:62 and :100 TableName() return records.TableNameFiles/TableNameAttachments, and WithLiveFile (gorm.go:140) hard-codes the same names in raw SQL; contrib/sqlc ships a fixed fs_ schema. A Store built with records.WithTablePrefix or WithTableNames is not followed by either. contrib/ent now takes FileMixin{Names: namer}. Acceptance: gorm and sqlc users have a documented way to follow the mapping, with a break-verified test; defaults unchanged.
title: contrib/gorm and contrib/sqlc do not follow records.WithTablePrefix/WithTableNames
